# Calder, transactional email infrastructure for developers
# One endpoint in (POST /v1/emails → 202), delivered events out (signed webhooks).
# Test keys simulate everything; live keys deliver. NGN + USD pricing, hard limits.
# Full content: /docs/llms-full.txt
